turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?

Hi! Of course.

Remember: always/usually/sometimes/never come **before** the main verb, and with he/she/it the verb gets **-s**.
Example: I never have coffee in the evening.

Exercise: Put the words in order:
"never / my uncle / drinks / coffee"
